title: Design system dot 3 group A + step 3: the committed probe-v10 measurements of JA Resort J 1.0.7, JA Essence/Impact/Nova/Vega WP, JA Kinetic J 1.0.9, Tracy Business J 1.2.6, JA Kinetic WP 1.0.11 and Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.23 judge clean; MODE-3 ignores a dark stylesheet nothing loads
steps: S1: Judge the committed design-system-measurement.json of the nine releases with judgeMeasurement and preview-system-issues.json, as /ops judges them (PREVIEW-PARITY on Joomla only).
S2: Run the MODE-3 readiness test, the design-system door test, the slot emitter test (cms.test.mjs) and the wp-ja-kinetic theme test.
expect: S1: every one of the 9 releases leaves 0 rules failing; only SCREEN-1 may warn.
S2: a dormant dark stylesheet is not applicable to MODE-3 while a loaded one still needs both modes measured; the door pins the new releases; the emitter and theme tests pass.
evidence: Committed v10 measurements of the nine releases plus the unit tests over readiness, the door and the slot emitter
fence: Measurement judging and readiness logic in tracy-web and tracy-ds-slot; does not drive a stand or a browser
